# Chattanooga Drainage Solutions

> Residential drainage contractor serving Chattanooga and Hamilton County, Tennessee: French drains, yard drainage systems, buried downspout lines, sump pumps, yard regrading, dry creek beds and erosion control, built for red clay and heavy annual rain. Free on-site water-flow assessments, firm written quotes.

## Contact
- Phone: (423) 401-9304
- Email: quotes@chattanoogadrainagesolutions.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7am to 6pm (urgent flooding into the house is prioritized)
- Free assessment form: https://chattanoogadrainagesolutions.com/contact.html

## Service area
Chattanooga, East Ridge, Red Bank, Hixson, Ooltewah, Signal Mountain, Soddy-Daisy, East Brainerd, and surrounding Hamilton County, TN.

## Services
- [French drain installation](https://chattanoogadrainagesolutions.com/french-drain.html): fixes standing water and wet foundations
- [Yard drainage systems](https://chattanoogadrainagesolutions.com/yard-drainage.html): catch basins, channel drains, buried pipe, surface and subsurface solutions
- [Downspout and gutter drainage](https://chattanoogadrainagesolutions.com/downspout-drainage.html): buried lines that carry roof water away from the foundation
- [Sump pump installation](https://chattanoogadrainagesolutions.com/sump-pump.html): basements and crawl spaces, battery backups, discharge lines
- [Yard grading and regrading](https://chattanoogadrainagesolutions.com/regrading.html): ground that slopes toward the house, low spots, negative grade
- [Dry creek beds and swales](https://chattanoogadrainagesolutions.com/dry-creek-beds.html): stone-lined surface drainage that looks like landscaping
- [Erosion control](https://chattanoogadrainagesolutions.com/erosion-control.html): washed-out slopes, gullies and bare hillsides stabilized

## Pricing guide
- [French drain cost in Chattanooga (2026)](https://chattanoogadrainagesolutions.com/french-drain-cost.html): $25 to $50 per linear foot for exterior yard systems, most full projects $2,500 to $6,000
